_about: Cast of Yooba Land. Captions are the exact in-game text. All media lazy-loaded.

cast.name: Yooba
cast.who: The little green wind-blown hungry one, new to Yooba Land.

cast.name: Pip (the other Yooba)
cast.who: A small, curious Yooba from town who thinks small fits places.

voice.caption: Are you new? Are you a farmer? Why are you so small?
I'm Pip! I'm small too. Small fits places.
Apples by the humming stone! Hold E and you can carry one. Or just eat it. I would.

cast.name: Old Reed
cast.who: A patient angler on the Glimmer Lake dock: the fish do not hurry.

voice.caption: ...You want to fish? Everyone wants to fish. Nobody wants to wait.
Tell Bramley the lake says hello. He'll know.

cast.name: Bramley
cast.who: The unhurried Seedvale farmer, hands full at harvest.

voice.caption: Harvest's in and my hands are full. Mind the rows.
Well now. A little green helper, right when the harvest's in.

cast.name: Kelp
cast.who: The loud, friendly sea captain of the Marmalade.

voice.caption: AHOY! A storm last night blew the lighthouse lamp clean out!
Hop aboard the Marmalade, end of the landing stage. I'll run you round to the point. HARR!

cast.name: Wren
cast.who: The Skyport pilot who means to fly everyone everywhere.

voice.caption: Wren here. Skyport's the top of the town's runway. One day I'll fly everyone everywhere.
Lumen's lamp is lit? Then the sea's safe and so's my sky.
Frostcap? Hop in. I'll get you to its foot. Not up it: the wind up there eats planes.
